programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: HMP Shrewsbury Part 3
programmes.d: The concluding part of the teams biggest investigation sees Yvette get the biggest shock of.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Abbey House Museum
programmes.d: Yvette introduces a brand new Most Haunted team member, Watson, a bulldog. This location starts to give up its mysteries as soon as the team arrive and they have go film differently to accommodate a particularly aggressive poltergeist.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Wentworth Woodhouse stable
programmes.d: The first team ever to be allowed into the very haunted Wentworth Woodhouse Stable Block and the team film the best evidence ever, has a ghost been caught on camera? Watson sees something and team see someone who couldn’t possibly have been there.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Slaughter House
programmes.d: The Slaughterhouse is Liverpool’s oldest pub and gives the team more than they bargained for as object are moved from underneath the team’s noses.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Todmoredon Church
programmes.d: For the first time Yvette takes her fearless Most Haunted team to an ordained church and graveyard. But it’s the cellar that proves the most fearful as the team get caught in a small room and they are not alone.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Weir Mill
programmes.d: Yvette take her team to an abandoned mill where spirits are said to roam and satanic ritual taken place. What awaits them is an evening of fear that causes one of the team to leave early.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Ripon Workhouse
programmes.d: In a place where the homeless were kept and work was hard, death was often the only escape but it seems that wasn’t the way for some as their souls are said to roam this place.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Ripon Prison
programmes.d: A small prison in Yorkshire gives a big impact when Yvette and her team attempt to stay the night. Although many inmates were released some are still locked up and they are not happy.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Standon Hall Part 1
programmes.d: Yvette Fielding and her team take on a three-part investigation that tests them to the very core. A place that surprised intrigued and terrified the hardened team, making Standon Hall the most fearful place they have investigated.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Standon Hall Part 2
programmes.d: Part two of this mammoth investigation and Yvette has some harsh words for Karl as he decides to take a risk that proves too dangerous. With something that wants them out, the investigation gets aggressive.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Standon Hall Part 3
programmes.d: The concluding part of the team’s most scary investigation to date, but will they last the night as something definitely wants them out.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Croxteth Hall Part 1
programmes.d: The team take on one of the grandest properties in Great Britain, Liverpool’s Croxteth Hall in a non-stop two-hour heart pounding investigation.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Croxteth Hall Part 2
programmes.d: We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The team seem to be stalked by something…but what.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Rowleys House
programmes.d: The team head to the centre of Shrewsbury and a large building that is all but empty.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Fleece Inn
programmes.d: This old pup in the heart of West Yorkshire is said to be one of the Most Haunted places in England.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Haden Hill House Part 1
programmes.d: An old house in England’s West Midlands gives the Most Haunted team a night they will never forget.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Haden Hill House Part 2
programmes.d: The strange occurrences at Hayden Hill House switch up a gear as whatever is there seems now to be stalking the team with some terrifying results, at least for some of the crew it is proving too much.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Old House
programmes.d: This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Keithley Bus Museum
programmes.d: Once an old foundry, this large old building houses vehicles from a bygone era that are said to still contain passengers whose destination has never ended.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Judges Lodgings Part 1
programmes.d: Yvette heads to Presteigne, Mid Wales and the famous Judges Lodgings, were courts were held, people imprisoned and Judges stayed, but it also holds many a secret.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Judges Lodgings Part 2
programmes.d: Most Haunted continues its investigation into the Judges Lodgings where the team seem to be under attack and something is trying to get through a door…but what?

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Codnor Castle Part 1
programmes.d: The team venture into a cottage where it is said ‘no living soul can endure living there’. With cursed dolls, murder and suicide this derelict place has everything to fear.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Codnor Castle Part 2
programmes.d: We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The foreboding Codnor Castle Cottage maintains its attack on the Most Haunted team with dramatic effect causing Yvette calls an early end to their night in Hell House.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Birmingham Central
programmes.d: Yvette takes her team to a disused prison in Birmingham which has housed some of the most notorious criminals in British history.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Dudley Castle
programmes.d: The ruins that make up Dudley Castle house a plethora of paranormal activity for Yvette and her team to investigate. Strange noises and a violent poltergeist await them as they turn the lights out and do battle with the unseen forces.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Llanfyliln House Part 1
programmes.d: Workhouses were not the best of places to be, so why would anyone stay after they had died? Yvette takes her team on a memorable journey to find out. For a few team members it was a night they will never forget as they are pushed to the very limits.
